thread:
maya: Quick sync — product asked for hard SLA per-tenant in EU region. Need to scope multi-region routing policy changes.
jordan: Do we mean per-tenant isolation lanes or reserved capacity? These are different costs/impacts.
maya: Customer wants geographic isolation + predictable p99 latency. They mentioned HIPAA workloads.
nina: If it's HIPAA, we need private deployment option + audit logs. For hosted, we can do tenant routing to EU-only pools with affinity.
kevin: Main tradeoff: strict tenant isolation => less bin-packing => higher infra cost. We should quantify cost delta before committing.
alejandra: Do we have a baseline cost model for dedicated lanes vs shared with soft-affinity? I can help run numbers.
maya: Goal for this thread: list launch criteria, open questions, and a proposed phasing (MVP -> hardened).
jordan: Proposed MVP: 1) region-aware routing rule, 2) soft tenant affinity with fallback, 3) telemetry dashboards per-tenant region. No hard capacity reservation yet.
nina: Acceptance criteria for MVP: documented routing policy, test harness for cross-region failover, and performance regression <10% for 95th.
kevin: Phased hardened launch: add reserved capacity with SLA, tenant quarantine playbook, and encrypted egress controls.
ops-bot: FYI — perf tests for soft-affinity show 15% cost increase at peak for high-surge tenants. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maya: That's higher than we'd like. Can we reduce by KV cache sharing or smarter batching?
kevin: Yes, caching prefixes across tenants in same model family helps. But for HIPAA customer cache sharing is tricky.
alejandra: Customer-driven ask: they want explicit SLAs (latency + uptime) and data residency. We should map requirements to product tiers: hosted-basic, dedicated, private.
jordan: Can we propose a gating checklist for sales handoff? e.g., verified infra cost estimate, legal sign-off on residency, runbook for failover, and canary plan.
maya: I'll draft gating checklist. Quick Q: who owns rollout for Dedicated lanes? eng-infra + product?
kevin: eng-infra implements routing and capacity; platform owns rollout config + CI; product coordinates sales & legal.
nina: Risk note: cross-region fallback must avoid violating data residency. Fallback only to EU DR nodes for EU-tagged tenants.
maya: Open action items: 1) alejandro/alejandra run cost delta numbers by EOD Wed; 2) kevin sketch infra design for soft vs hard affinity; 3) jordan draft gating checklist; 4) nina confirm HIPAA constraints with compliance.
alejandra: Ack. I'll also prepare a one-pager for sales with expected TCO delta.
kevin: I'll drop an initial infra diagram in #architecture-docs and tag you all.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: RFC posted — "tenant-region-affinity-v1" https://redwood.example/rfc/tenant-region-affinity-v1
maya: Thanks — will review RFC and loop legal.
jordan: Let's sync Wed 10am PT for decision. :calendar: \nmaya: Sounds good. Closing thread until sync. :thumbsup:
